# mockingbird_contract_version (Resource)

One contract version of a mock, for explicit version history: every change of the source creates a new version (versions are immutable, so this resource is replaced). Destroying it only forgets the version, which the Admin API keeps. Do not combine with `contract` on the same `mockingbird_mock`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mockingbird_mock" "billing" {
  name = "billing"
}

# Each change of the file uploads a new, immutable version and activates it.
resource "mockingbird_contract_version" "billing" {
  mock     = mockingbird_mock.billing.name
  file     = "${path.module}/contracts/billing.yaml"
  activate = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mock` (String) Name of the mock.

### Optional

- `activate` (Boolean) Keep this version active. When another version has been activated since, the next apply activates this one again. Default `true`.
- `content` (String) The contract inline.
- `file` (String) Path of a contract file, read at plan time.
- `url` (String) http(s) URL of the contract, fetched at plan time.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace of the resource. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) The contract's `info.version`.
- `id` (String) Identifier, `<workspace>/<mock>/<version>`; also the import ID.
- `operations` (List of String) The operations, as targets such as `GET /orders/{id}`, `query user` or `/pkg.Service/Method`.
- `source_sha256` (String) Hex sha256 of the source; a change replaces the version.
- `status` (String) `draft`, `approved`, `active` or `archived`.
- `title` (String) The contract's `info.title`.
- `version` (Number) The version number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A contract version is imported as <workspace>/<mock>/<version>.
terraform import mockingbird_contract_version.billing default/billing/3
```
